channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Masons support the Salvation Army food shelf
item.description: Shrine Masons give $11,187 to the Salvation Army food shelf, part of a bell-ringing effort dating to the 1950s that has raised $263,200 for the area food shelf since 2010.

item.title: Joseph Company receives top award for Paramount Theatre project
item.description: Austin’s Joseph Company earns ABC’s top Eagle Award for its 2025 restoration and expansion of the Paramount Theatre, including larger lobby, concessions and back-of-house space.

item.title: Cannon Ball Run: Austin senior Chloe Cannon leads Packers in second half surge over AL
item.description: Scoreless at half, Austin senior Chloe Cannon hits all 9 after break as Packers hold off Albert Lea 65-55; Gracie Arndt posts 20 points, 14 rebounds.

item.title: Hall scores twice as Packers top Marshall
item.description: Hall scores twice, including a short-handed game-winner, as Austin boys hockey tops Marshall 3-1 on the road.

item.title: Lyle-Pacelli boys take down LeRoy-Ostrander
item.description: Lyle-Pacelli boys roll past LeRoy-Ostrander 71-50 as Alex Lagunas scores 20 points; LP improves to 7-11 overall, while LeRoy-Ostrander falls to 5-10.

item.title: Packer gymnasts take third in Mankato
item.description: Austin gymnastics places third at Mankato meet; sophomore Callie McRae finishes fourth all-around and earns second on vault and third on floor.

item.title: Unbeaten JWP takes it to Blooming Prairie boys basketball team
item.description: Undefeated Janesville-Waldorf-Pemberton rolls past Blooming Prairie 88-54, despite 19 points from Gabe Staloch for BP.

item.title: Rebel girls defeat Chatfield behind Galle's 19
item.description: Breeley Galle scores 19 as Southland girls edge Chatfield 61-55 in Adams, improving the Rebels to 16-2 overall.

item.title: Bruins score five first period goals to beat Mallards
item.description: EJ Paddington’s hat trick and five first‑period goals powered the Austin Bruins to a 7-2 road win over the Minnesota Mallards on Friday.

item.title: Packers slip past Tigers in AL
item.description: Cole Hebrink scores 16 as Austin edges Albert Lea 65-63 in AL boys basketball.
